what: Molina Healthcare runs health plans for people on government programmes: Medicaid for low-income Americans, Medicare for older ones, and marketplace plans under the Affordable Care Act.
customers: State Medicaid agencies and the federal government, which pay Molina a fixed amount per member per month.
money: managed care for state Medicaid programmes
plans for people eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid
individual plans sold on the exchanges
moat: State Medicaid contracts won through competitive procurement and then held for years, in a business where only a few companies have the scale and track record to bid.
risks: A net loss of $48M as medical costs ran ahead of the rates states pay
Medicaid enrolment fell after pandemic-era continuous coverage ended, and the people who stayed are sicker
A 1.0% margin means a small miss on medical costs wipes out the profit
opportunities: Revenue grew from $27.8B to $45.4B in four years
States reprice Medicaid rates annually, so cost pressure eventually feeds into higher payments
watch: The medical cost ratio and whether state rate updates catch up with costs.
